description: One-shot selfie segmentation via the MediaPipe TouchDesigner engine (install with `tdmcp install mediapipe-touchdesigner`). Loads the engine, enables Selfie Segmentation, and builds an adapter COMP with a clean alpha-mask Null TOP (optionally inverted and/or feathered) plus an optional pre-keyed RGBA Null TOP (person on transparent). Wire the mask into create_keyer, create_depth_silhouette, or any matte-consuming tool. The engine reuses an existing MediaPipe op if already loaded (idempotent). Keep the TD timeline PLAYING so the embedded browser captures the webcam; click Allow if macOS prompts for camera permission.

feather_px.description: Soft-edge blur radius on the mask before publishing (Blur TOP). 0 = hard mask.

invert_mask.description: Output 1 − mask (useful for background-only effects). Applied via a Level TOP on the mask branch.

model.description: Selfie-segmentation model variant. 'general' works at any orientation; 'landscape' is tuned for wide-angle scenes.

name.description: Adapter COMP name under parent_path. Defaults to 'mp_segmentation'.

parent_path.description: COMP to load the engine into. Reuses the existing engine if MediaPipe already exists.

publish_prekeyed.description: Also build a person_rgba Null TOP (camera × mask) so you can drop 'person on transparent' straight into a comp.

smooth.description: Enable the engine's mask temporal smoothing parameter if present.

tox_path.description: Path to the MediaPipe ENGINE .tox (MediaPipe.tox). Defaults to the package staged by `tdmcp install mediapipe-touchdesigner`, falling back to the legacy ~/tdmcp-packages path.

name: setup_segmentation
title: Set up selfie segmentation
